tytul: Spiced ginger syrup: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for spiced ginger syrup.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to Ask Extension, ginger and turmeric have pH levels above the safe level for canning in a boiling water bath, and honey and sugar syrups can harbor botulism spores.
The FDA list gives ginger a pH of about 5.60–5.90.

akapity: According to Ask Extension, there are no research-based recipes for canning infused simple syrups.
Almost any food that is not very acidic, with a pH above 4.6, can support the growth of Clostridium botulinum and toxin production.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for ginger syrup from a checked source.
